Demo._note: Public-edition defaults. Demo mode seeds synthetic data and keeps every outbound integration off. See docs/PUBLIC-EDITION.md.

Agents._note: demo = scripted jarvis-demo-agent adapter (no model, no edits). cli = real Claude Code / Codex CLIs on PATH.

ExternalActions._note: Master switch for side effects that leave the machine or touch the OS: email, Teams/Graph, push notifications, away-mode daemon, media/volume/lock/app launch.
